metadata.title: Terminal-Scalar-Aware Compilation of Quadratic Scores for CKKS
metadata.description: Research artifact for terminal-scalar-aware compilation of public quadratic scores for CKKS. The compiler orients cyclic offsets before existing Lattigo direct/BSGS lowering, preserving the terminal scalar score. Includes a nine-page paper, implementation, frozen models and encrypted execution records, reproducible scripts, and a checked Lean 4 project. General algebraic preservation and restricted support optimality are proved for every positive dimension; encrypted evaluation covers dimensions 8, 16 and 32 at batch 128. Measured speed and memory changes are plan-dependent; no global circuit optimality, uniform CKKS error theorem, new security proof, or historical priority is claimed. Code and Lean: MIT. Paper, documentation and research data: CC BY 4.0. See the scoped license and verification-boundary documents in the source archive.
